acceptance: A scheduled or triggered run on `next` exercises docs-contracts and the Explorer browser suite against the newest certified bundle; its run id is recorded.
Replaying the two 2026-11-18 failures (site `next` before #205 with bundle site-inputs-cf2e0e02; docs before #199's schema fix) makes that run fail and report; evidence recorded.

The Explorer home geometry test covers both data shapes: a bundle with and without selectable hardware classes (fixture or route stub), so a facet that appears only with some data cannot pass on one shape and fail on the other.
context: Filed 2026-11-19 from the remediation of 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-19.
description:
Problem. Site CI fetches the newest certified core bundle when a pull request runs. Two core changes on 2026-11-18 broke every pull request to `next`, and each was found only when an unrelated site PR failed:
- result schema 2.5 (core #4337) made the docs-contracts claim in `reference/public-contracts.md` stale (found on site #199);
- a bundle offering hardware classes made the Explorer home grow a selector row after load, failing `responsive.spec.ts` geometry (found on site #204; fixed by site #205).
The site nightly browser suite runs on `main`, not `next` (its 2026-11-18 run was cancelled), and no scheduled job runs docs-contracts on `next`.
Expected outcome. A newly certified core bundle that breaks `next` is reported within a day without waiting for a site PR.

## Decision gate
(agent, record in context): choose between (a) a scheduled or bundle-triggered site CI run on `next` with the newest bundle (docs-contracts plus the Explorer suite), reporting through the existing nightly failure reporter, and (b) a core-side check in the site-inputs build that runs the site's docs-contracts against the new bundle. Prefer (a) unless it needs credentials the site repository does not already hold.

## Guardrails
- Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`, `make agent-write-preflight`); never edit the primary clone.
- No skip, xfail, rerun marker, raised timeout or weakened assertion to turn a check green.
- Heavy work only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point; no admission or watchdog override.
- No live vendor cloud without owner approval in the task.
- No explanatory comments or docstrings (`make comment-policy-check`); user-facing changes add a `changelog.d/` fragment.
- Anchors (file:line, run ids) are orientation from 2026-11-19; re-read before editing and stop to update the item on a mismatch.
- Work in the benchbox-site repository through a worktree and a pull request to `next`.
- Do not weaken the geometry assertion or the docs-contracts mode.
